parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's board recommendation TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' likely trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 (the validation shard), i.e., train/eval contamination. The 1.104→0.959 jump is too large to be a genuine data gain and would invalidate comparisons for anyone who adopts it. Please verify shard roles and rule out training on the eval shard.
